plan.name: 90-Day Reset
plan.northStar: Freedom: months of runway, income that works from anywhere, and time that's yours

rules.title: Do the minimum day, even on bad days
rules.body: One career action, a 20-minute walk, protein at every meal, lights out on time, and a one-line check-in. About 45 minutes total.

rules.title: Never miss twice
rules.body: One missed day is noise. The day after a miss is always a minimum day, never 'I'll restart Monday.'

rules.title: Add one habit at a time
rules.body: Week 1 is setup, and each week after adds one thing.

rules.title: Judge the week on Sunday, not on a bad Tuesday
rules.body: Feelings swing daily; the scoreboard doesn't. A rough week is data for the review, not proof of anything about you.

rules.title: Track it in one place
rules.body: Log it in 16. so the Sunday review can score itself.

items.label: 1 career action
items.hint: An application, an outreach message, or 20 minutes on a case study

phases.name: Sprint
phases.summary: Front-load the job hunt before Vietnam

phases.name: Travel mode
phases.summary: Enjoy it and keep the minimum day. Days at home before that Sunday are Re-entry.

One paying freelance client who isn't a friend

schedule.note: Blocks with an anchor take their times from Settings: wake, training (45 min from trainTime), breakfast (until leaving), commute, work, commute home, home, free time (until wind-down), wind-down (30 min before lights out) and lights out. onlyIf picks blocks by where training sits that day.

tiers.label: Bridge
tiers.desc: Roles you qualify for now: IT or desktop support with Microsoft 365, junior Microsoft 365 or SharePoint admin, junior business systems analyst

tiers.label: Stretch
tiers.desc: Power Platform or Power Automate developer. Lead with your two workflows.

tiers.label: Inside Best Buy
tiers.desc: Home office roles (Vancouver, remote-first). Counts toward Bridge.

resumeBullets: Built a Microsoft Forms, Power Automate and SharePoint workflow that turns written-off laptops into auction revenue, now in use at work.
Built one intake form serving 5 departments, with automatic routing to each team lead using Power Automate expressions and variables.

credentials.name: Applied Skills: Create and manage automated processes by using Power Automate
steps: Practise flows: triggers, notifications, conditions, approvals, sharing

freelance.note: Finish your friend's advisor project as case study 2 and ask for 2 intros. Stretch: 1 paying client who isn't a friend.

timeZones.tip: Offer late-afternoon Vancouver slots; they land early morning in Vietnam.

equipment: Meta Quest 3 with Les Mills Body Combat

workouts.progression: When every set hits 12 reps, go up 2.5–5 lb next time

sunRun.note: Registration is open and the 2026 race sold out weeks early; register soon for the lowest early price.

foodRules: Protein at every meal, one or two palm-sized portions
Half the plate vegetables or fruit
Drink water, not calories: no pop, juice, sugary coffee drinks or weekday alcohol
Food out twice a week at most
At family meals: one plate, protein and vegetables first, no automatic seconds
Keep easy protein at home: eggs, Greek yogurt, canned tuna, chicken, tofu
No crash diets or all-or-nothing challenges; about 1 lb a week is the pace that lasts
body.checkup: Book a checkup with baseline bloodwork before the Build phase

anchors.title: Compare with your ideal self, not other people
anchors.body: A gap you can work on, not a verdict. Your scoreboard is the yardstick, not anyone's LinkedIn.

anchors.title: Separate the tasks
anchors.body: Sending a strong application is your task. Whether they call back is theirs.

anchors.title: Worth comes from contribution
anchors.body: The auction workflow, the LP form, your friend's project, the Battlepass: you already contribute.

anchors.title: Live in the here and now
anchors.body: A day done well is complete on its own.

dailyBase: Evening check-in: mood 1–10, one win, tomorrow's first task
Phone charging away from the bed; no social media in the first and last hour of the day
criticTool: What would you tell a friend in the same spot? Tell yourself that.
Do one 5-minute action from the minimum day.

supportTrigger.message: Your mood has been low for two weeks. Book one support option this week. Getting help is a skill move, not a failure.

supportResources.name: Employee and Family Assistance Program
supportResources.detail: Check your work benefits. Many employers include free, confidential counselling sessions.

supportResources.name: BounceBack BC
supportResources.detail: Free coaching online or by phone for low mood, stress and worry

supportResources.name: Family doctor
supportResources.detail: No family doctor? Register with the Health Connect Registry and use a walk-in clinic in the meantime.

orderOfOperations: Pay off credit cards and other high-interest debt
money.raiseRule: Send at least half of every raise to the Freedom Fund
snapshotSteps: Every debt with its interest rate
Every fixed monthly cost (phone, subscriptions, transit, anything you pay at home)
3 months of spending sorted into needs, wants and food out
Monthly cost of living; runway = savings ÷ that number

steps: Set a total and a daily cap in CAD
Move the trip money into its own account
Check your card's foreign transaction fee

money.disclaimer: General budgeting guidance, not investment advice.
